composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a slate-roof cottage beside a low orchard wall. Keep the trees low enough that their canopies do not intrude into the upper fifth. The cottage doorway and stone gate create a clear central path. Use pale morning light, a few moss seams, and soft foliage clusters. No ripe-fruit close-ups or people are needed; the modest built landscape should feel complete. Use watercolor landscape architecture. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
